tasks.label: ROS2 Humble: build IK and markers
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && exec /usr/bin/colcon build --base-paths piper_kinematics piper_ros/src/piper_msgs piper_ros/src/piper_description piper_ros/src/piper --executor sequential --event-handlers console_direct+ --cmake-args -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
tasks.detail: Build the migrated IK, interactive marker, Piper messages, robot description and driver launch configuration with ROS2 Humble.

tasks.label: ROS2 Humble: build perception
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && COLCON_EXTENSION_BLOCKLIST=colcon_notification.desktop_notification exec /usr/bin/colcon build --base-paths graspgen_camera graspgen_vision graspgen_handeye --executor sequential --event-handlers desktop_notification-
